_comment: OAuth credentials store — populated by `picoclaw auth login <provider>` inside the tenant container, or auto-copied at provision time from /etc/picoclaw/shared-auth.json on the controlplane host. Schema matches pkg/auth/store.go::AuthStore: a top-level 'credentials' map keyed by canonical provider name. Each entry is an AuthCredential: {access_token, refresh_token?, account_id?, expires_at?, provider, auth_method, email?, project_id?}. Canonical providers seen by the auth subsystem: 'anthropic', 'codex' (OpenAI CLI), 'google-antigravity'. Unknown fields are ignored by the loader, so this scaffold ships empty and gets filled as operators log in.
